title: The Ideas of Israel – European Council on Foreign Relations
gist: ECFR podcast episode promoting Beth Oppenheim's web special arguing that illiberal and ethno-nationalist forces are remaking Israel in a shift deeper than electoral politics that will outlast Netanyahu. It cites Netanyahu's September 2025 call for a 'super-Sparta' Israel with an autarkic economy and self-sufficient arms industry.

insights.claim: In September 2025 Binyamin Netanyahu told Israelis their country was in 'a sort of isolation' and would need to become a 'super-Sparta', with an economy of 'autarkic characteristics' and an arms industry able to produce what it needs.
insights.speaker: Ariel David, Mark Leonard, Beth Oppenheim, Neri Zilber
insights.so_what: Signals an Israeli push toward defence-industrial self-sufficiency and economic insulation, implying more domestic arms production and potential friction with Western trade partners.
insights.quote: would need to become a “super-Sparta”: its economy would have “autarkic characteristics”

insights.claim: The 'super-Sparta' vision is a long way from the close ties to the West that Israel's founders foresaw.
insights.speaker: Ariel David, Mark Leonard, Beth Oppenheim, Neri Zilber
insights.so_what: Suggests a structural drift in Israel's Western alignment with implications for EU-Israel relations.

insights.claim: Beth Oppenheim's ECFR web special argues illiberal and ethno-nationalist forces are remaking Israel in their image, in a shift that runs deeper than electoral politics and will outlast Netanyahu.
insights.speaker: Ariel David, Mark Leonard, Beth Oppenheim, Neri Zilber
insights.so_what: Europe should not expect a change of Israeli leadership alone to reverse Israel's policy direction.
insights.quote: illiberal and ethno-nationalist forces are remaking Israel in their image, in a shift that runs deeper than electoral politics—and that will outlast Netanyahu
insights.locator: This vision of Israel is a long way

source_meta.author: Ariel David, Mark Leonard, Beth Oppenheim, Neri Zilber
